name: RYNOQUIP RS - 05 Skid Steer 23hp Honda GX690
source_description:
Developed by RYNOQUIP in Australia, this skid steer fills a current void for our acreage and contractor customers.

Combines big skid hydraulic flow and Honda V-Twin reliability to create a compact machine that is capable of running serious attachments like mulchers, trenchers and stump grinders.

Powered by a Honda v-twin and triple hydraulic pumps with substantially upgraded auxiliary flow.

Features:
 • Standard 4 in 1 bucket
 • 2 speed travel!
 • True hydraulic float function
 •  Self levelling attachment
 • Hydraulic cooling upgrade
 • Spin on service filters to keep the system reliable and easy to maintain.
 • Undercarriage features 4 load rollers including an integrated tensioner roller to avoid the common track issues on other machines.
 • Upgraded triple stack of hydraulic pumps

Specifications
 • Honda GX690 V-Twin
 • 480KG rated capacity (with ballast pack)
 • 40+ litres per minute AUXILERY FLOW @ 2600psi
 • 900kg operating weight

Covered by a 12 month part warranty and local support, this machine sets the benchmark for acreage owners and tight access contractor work.
The Honda is exceptionally smooth and makes 48.3 NM of torque at only 2500RPM, outperforming diesel options in the class, with legendary Honda reliability!

name: RS07 Skid Steer Loader
source_description:
Powered by Kubota D1105 Engine | Four-Pump Hydraulic System | Built for Heavy-Duty Work The RIPPA RS07 skid steer loader is a high-performance, professional-grade machine designed to tackle demanding tasks in construction, municipal maintenance, and landscaping. Equipped with the fuel-efficient Kubota D1105 engine and an advanced four-pump hydraulic system, the RS07 delivers consistent power, precision control, and unmatched versatility across multiple job types.

Key Features of the RIPPA RS07 Skid Steer Loader Kubota D1105 Engine – High Power with Low Fuel Consumption The RS07 features the trusted Kubota D1105 diesel engine, delivering strong and stable power output while maintaining excellent fuel efficiency. It is engineered to support heavy-duty operations, ensuring reliable performance across long working hours and challenging jobsite conditions.
Advanced Four-Pump Hydraulic System (48+48+28.2+48 L/min)This model is equipped with a high-capacity hydraulic setup, including:
Two tandem closed-loop pumps
An internal charge pump
One gear pump
Together, they deliver a total hydraulic flow of 172.2 L/min, ensuring balanced power distribution, responsive multi-function control, and efficient energy use, even during simultaneous high-load operations.

Pilot-Controlled Multi-Way Valve – Smooth and Precise HandlingThe pilot-operated control system guarantees accurate and agile maneuvering, allowing the operator to manage attachments and loader functions with ease and precision for a seamless work experience.
2 Auxiliary Hydraulic Lines + 1 Return Line With two main auxiliary hydraulic circuits and a dedicated return (unloading) line, the RS07 supports fast and flexible integration with a wide array of attachments, boosting adaptability on-site.
30-Second Quick Coupler System Featuring an industry-standard quick-attach interface, operators can switch between attachments in under 30 seconds, reducing downtime and maximizing productivity on the jobsite.

One Machine – Dozens of Attachments, Compatible with a broad range of work tools, including:
Earth augers
Hydraulic breakers
Quick couplers
Rippers
Snowplows
4-in-1 buckets
Dozer blades and many more!
This makes the RS07 ideal for digging, drilling, lifting, leveling, demolition, snow removal, and other specialized tasks.

Benefits of the RIPPA RS07 Skid Steer Loader - Kubota-powered reliability for long-term use
172+ L/min total flow hydraulic system for high-performance applications
Responsive pilot controls for operator comfort
Multi-attachment versatility for diverse work needs
Quick coupling interface for time-saving attachment swaps
Factory-direct pricing with global distribution support
Available from overseas warehouses with after-sales support

Technical Specification Overview Engine Kubota D1105Hydraulic System 4-pump (48+48+28.2+48 L/min)Hydraulic Control Pilot multi-way valve Auxiliary Lines 2 main + 1 unloading line Quick Coupler 30-second switch compatible Attachment Compatibility 20+ types (bucket, auger, breaker…)Application Scenarios Construction, municipal, landscaping
Looking for a high-powered, precision-controlled skid steer loader? The RIPPA RS07 is built to meet your toughest demands. Whether you’re a contractor, farmer or for personal use.
